description: Review the project's own code before shipping. Runs Shippable's code checks on the project folder (edge functions nobody authenticates, HTML built from request data, redirects taken from the request, database rules users can abuse, open storage) and returns a checklist for you to work through by reading the code: caller checks, plan limits enforced only in the frontend, email HTML, payments, tables users can edit, storage. Use it before shipping; it complements shippable_scan, which checks the running app from outside. Read-only; your code never leaves the machine.

projectDir.description: Absolute path of the project folder. Defaults to the server's working directory.

name: shippable_review_code
title: Shippable code review
